title: Tomyris
summary: Raleigh names Tomyris in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Tomyris, Queene of the Massagetes, who in Herodotus cut off the head of Cyrus. Ctesias calleth her Sparetha, the wife of Amorges, and that equation was not made a second woman. Tomyrique is the name of the warre, and was not made a person. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
